title: 第一章 丹帝重生
content_zh:
“这是什么破地方？竟然这么冷？”

    随着一声咒骂，大红鸳鸯被中缓缓露出半个脑袋，不过他的表情从痛苦到震惊，最后变成狂喜。

    “本帝还活着？”

    “不，本帝是重生了，九龙造世鼎果然没让本帝失望。”

    前世他位居神武大陆三大丹帝之首，只要渡过最后一劫，就能问鼎丹神，成为万古第一丹神，然而在渡劫的紧要关头，发生了意外，他布下的抵挡劫雷的阵法竟然失效，他的肉身在劫雷下化为灰烬。

    好在他在危险关头，他祭出了他毕生的最得意的丹炉，九龙造世鼎，器灵将他的神魂收进了丹鼎之中，这才让他有了重生的机会。

    任天一闭目回想，搜索着肉身的记忆，只是脑袋里几乎空空如也，记忆中自己重生的肉身也叫任天一，是神武大陆，星落城，任家的第六子，一位不招人待见的公子。

    适应了新的肉身，任天一环顾四周，璀璨的红烛，屋内箱笼框桌都贴上了大红喜字，珠光把整个房间照得犹如梦般香艳。

    “洞房？”

    昨天正是任天一洞房花烛，然而还没来及洞房，他就被新娘白婧身上爆发出的寒气瞬间冰冻，随后就失去了意识，然后他的洞房花烛夜就就没有然后了。

    关于白婧，任天一并没有找到太多的信息，只知道白婧是星落城的一位“名人”，原因是白婧的样貌，半边脸美若天仙，另外半边脸却是因为胎记，丑陋无比，犹如半个仙子和半只鬼的结合体，人称“鬼仙”。

    同时，白婧还身患绝症，修炼受限，传言她活不过十八岁，今年恰好十七岁，和任天一同岁。

    而任天一则是先天绝脉，根本无法修炼，在任家也是一个只知道吃饭和睡觉的废人，活的不如一个体面的下人，他和白婧的婚姻，就是一个政治婚姻，而他和她都是毫无反抗的余地。

    “呵呵，你俩还真是天生一对啊，本帝既然拥有了你的肉身，会好好照顾这身体的，这一世本帝不为丹道，只为逍遥。”

    对自己的处境有了一个初步的了解，任天一不禁轻笑道，前一世他一心向往丹道，直到天劫焚身才发现自己一生是何其悲哀，一生醉心丹道，完全没有领略人生的乐趣与快意。
content_en:
"What kind of crappy place is this? Is it so cold?"

    With a curse, half of the big red mandarin duck's head slowly emerged from the quilt, but his expression changed from pain to shock, and finally turned into ecstasy.

    "Is this emperor still alive?"

    "No, I am reborn, and the Nine Dragons World-Creating Cauldron did not disappoint me."

    In his previous life, he ranked first among the three great alchemy emperors in the Shenwu Continent. As long as he survived the last tribulation, he could aspire to be the alchemy god and become the number one alchemy god in eternity. However, at the critical moment of overcoming the tribulation, an accident occurred. The formation he had set up to resist the tribulation thunder failed, and his body was reduced to ashes under the tribulation thunder.

    Fortunately, at the critical moment, he sacrificed his most proud alchemy furnace in his life, the Nine Dragons Creation Cauldron. The weapon spirit took his soul into the alchemy cauldron, which gave him a chance to be reborn.

    Ren Tianyi closed his eyes and thought back, searching for the memory of his physical body, but his head was almost empty. In his memory, his reborn physical body was also called Ren Tianyi. He was the sixth son of the Ren family in Shenwu Continent, Xingluo City, and an unpopular young master.

    After getting used to his new body, Ren Tianyi looked around. The bright red candles, the boxes and tables in the room were all covered with red words "Happiness", and the pearl light illuminated the whole room as fragrant as a dream.

    "Bridal chamber?"

    Yesterday was Ren Tian's bridal night, but before he could reach the bridal chamber, he was instantly frozen by the cold air emitting from his bride Bai Jing's body, and then lost consciousness. Then his bridal night was over.

    Regarding Bai Jing, Ren Tianyi did not find much information. He only knew that Bai Jing was a "celebrity" in Xingluo City. The reason was because of her appearance. Half of her face was as beautiful as a fairy, while the other half was extremely ugly due to a birthmark. She was like a combination of half fairy and half ghost, so she was called "Ghost Fairy".

    At the same time, Bai Jing is also suffering from a terminal illness and her cultivation is limited. It is rumored that she will not live to be eighteen years old. She happens to be seventeen this year, the same age as Ren Tian.

    Ren Tianyi, on the other hand, was born with no pulse and could not cultivate at all. In the Ren family, he was also a useless person who only knew how to eat and sleep. His life was not as good as that of a decent servant. His marriage to Bai Jing was a political marriage, and neither he nor she had any room for resistance.

    "Haha, you two are really a perfect match. Since I have your physical body, I will take good care of it. In this life, I am not for alchemy, but for freedom."

    Having a preliminary understanding of his situation, Ren Tianyi couldn't help but chuckle and said that in his previous life, he was devoted to the alchemy path. It was not until he was burned in the calamity that he realized how miserable his life was. He was obsessed with the alchemy path and completely failed to appreciate the fun and pleasure of life.
title_en: Chapter 1 The Rebirth of the Alchemy Emperor
